description: See your GitHub merge queues in the sidebar and get alerted when your PR merges or gets kicked out.
viewContainer.title: Merge Queues
view.queues.name: Merge Queues
welcome.noRepos:
Track a GitHub merge queue to see its pull requests here and get alerted when yours merge or get removed.
[Add repository](command:mqTracker.addRepo)
[Learn about merge queues](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/incorporating-changes-from-a-pull-request/merging-a-pull-request-with-a-merge-queue)
welcome.signIn:
Sign in to GitHub to see the merge queues you track.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:mqTracker.signIn)
config.repos: Repositories whose merge queues to track, as `{ "repo": "owner/name", "branch": "main" }`. Leave `branch` out to use the repository's default branch. At most 20.
config.repos.branch: Branch whose merge queue to watch. Defaults to the repository's default branch.
config.pollSeconds: Seconds between polls while the window is focused. Minimum 15.
config.notify: Show a notification when one of your pull requests merges or is removed from a queue.
config.enterpriseUri: GitHub Enterprise Server URL, for example `https://github.example.com`. Leave empty for github.com. Also set `#github-enterprise.uri#` so VS Code can sign you in.
